free_tier.stated: No free tier is published. During public preview the published meters are USD 0.083 per device minute for Device Run on physical devices, USD 0.15 per device minute for Device Streaming on physical devices and USD 0.017 per device minute for emulators; billed per second with a 1 minute minimum. Standard pay-per-use rates from April 2027 are USD 0.20 per device minute, and subscriptions from April 2027 are USD 250 per device slot per month for physical devices and USD 200 per device slot per month for emulators.
free_tier.notes: The product page labels the rates 'Pay-per-use pricing during public preview'; a separate column publishes 'Pay-per-use standard pricing April 2027' and 'Subscription pricing (starts April 2027)'. No zero-cost allowance is named on the page read.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a device session, not a stored object

retention.stated: not stated: the pricing and quickstart pages read do not name a retention period for device-session output

egress.terms: No egress price or allowance is published on the pricing page read. All network traffic generated by DDP devices originates from published CIDR blocks, listed on the IP blocks page.

interface_detail: Android Studio, AI Studio, gcloud CLI and REST APIs; the REST reference names the Device Run and Device Streaming APIs, and the CLI reference names gcloud beta device-run and gcloud alpha device-run.
tooling: gcloud beta device-run, gcloud alpha device-run, the Device Run and Device Streaming REST APIs, and the Android Studio and AI Studio integrations.
chaining: Device Run sessions read test inputs from Cloud Storage buckets granted to the service agent and write outputs back, so a device-farm run chains with a Cloud Storage record for anything that must survive the session.

limits.value: USD 0.017 per emulator minute, USD 0.083 per physical Device Run minute and USD 0.15 per physical Device Streaming minute during public preview; billed per second with a 1 minute minimum

limits_note: No numeric quota is published on the resources page read; it links Pricing, Release notes, IP blocks and Troubleshooting only. The 1 minute minimum is the smallest billable unit per session.
binding_note: No published count quota was found; the chargeable minute with its 1 minute minimum is the only stated per-session constraint, so it binds first for a cost-driven workload.

identity_cost.detail: The quickstart states 'These documents assume you are a Google Cloud user with projects and accounts' and asks an administrator to grant IAM roles (Viewer, Device Run Admin, Device Streaming Admin, Service Usage Consumer, plus Cloud Storage roles). No separate DDP sign-up with a card or phone is stated on the pages read; a card gate for the underlying Google Cloud billing account is unverified: not stated on the DDP pages.

reliability_note: The product is in public preview and is marked Pre-GA: 'Pre-GA products and features are available "as is" and might have limited support.' The pricing page says rates change to standard pricing and subscriptions in April 2027.
confidence_note: Rates, interface and identity gate are quoted from the vendor's own product page, pricing page and quickstart, all read 2026-11-24; the absence of a published free tier and numeric quota is recorded as absence of evidence on those pages.
